overview: Mirabel grew 21.0 percent between 2016 and 2021 to reach 61,108 residents, one of the fastest growth rates in Quebec. Households are comfortable, with a median income of $90,000 in 2020, and the city's 24,795 occupied dwellings are spread over 484.09 square kilometres, most of it farmland.

Aerospace anchors the economy, led by the Airbus airliner plant at the airport, while agriculture still covers most of the territory. For a local business, that means young, well-paid families arriving quickly, a strong industrial supply chain, and customers scattered across several distinct village sectors.
